text:
joel: Noticed a bunch of support tickets where samples blow up after an API key rotate. Error in logs is a 401 and users forgot to set the project env.
priya: ouch. So runtime requires REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT? That's surprising for newcomers.
joel: yes. older sample apps assumed project was pinned in CI. when keys rotate, devs only paste new key and CI fails. reproducible locally: 
```bash
# before rotate
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-old-xxx
export REDWOOD_PROJECT=org:proj-42
# after rotate dev updated only the key
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-new-yyy
# app startup -> AUTH 401 from SDK
```
ben: we should make SDK more forgiving. proposal: 1) accept a single combined env REDWOOD_KEY_SCOPE="sk-xxx:proj-42" 2) fallback order: REDWOOD_KEY_SCOPE -> REDWOOD_API_KEY+REDWOOD_PROJECT -> ~/.redwood/credentials -> interactive prompt 3) when SDK receives 401 with "missing project scope" message it should do one reload of env/credentials and retry once (not a network retry).
devx-bot: cli idea: `rw auth migrate --auto --from-env REDWOOD_API_KEY --project-env REDWOOD_PROJECT` which will write a normalized entry to `~/.redwood/credentials` and print a one-time banner. Also emits telemetry event `auth.migrate.run` (anonymous).
priya: +1 to migration CLI. For sample apps we should add `scripts/normalize-env.sh` that will detect legacy envs and rewrite to REDWOOD_KEY_SCOPE for local dev. saves support noise.
infra-bot: Heads-up: adding REDWOOD_KEY_SCOPE will require docs + deprecation note for 30 days. Recommend a feature-flag rollout for 7 days and add a server-side compatibility check.
ben: SDK API change: expose `onAuthRefresh` hook so host apps can plug in token fetchers (useful for ephemeral keys). Also add a `retryOnAuthReload` boolean default true. If false, app gets original behavior.
ci-bot: test checklist suggestion: unit test for env precedence, integration test where project env is missing and SDK reloads+retries, e2e sample app run in CI with migration script.
joel: plan: (1) implement env fallback + one-time reload-retry in SDK (non-breaking), (2) add `rw auth migrate` CLI (opt-in), (3) patch samples to run normalize script, (4) docs + deprecation notice. Priya/Ben will pair on sdk PR, I can own sample updates.
priya: i'll add telemetry for when fallback triggers (event: `auth.fallback.trigger`) so we can measure how many customers rely on fallback. keep it coarse (count only).
ben: quick UX note: when fallback triggers, print a clear actionable message: "Missing project scope. We tried to recover by reading REDWOOD_KEY_SCOPE or ~/.redwood/credentials. Run `rw auth migrate` to persist a normalized credential."
joel: I'll file a support follow-up linking this thread and the repro. Thanks team :+1:
